title: Vocello CLI NDJSON record
description: One NDJSON record of --output-format ndjson. A stream holds records of one requestID with seq counting from 0 and t never decreasing, and ends with exactly one result record whose data is the envelope. Consumers ignore record types they do not know.

schemaVersion.description: The record's schema version: 1 for every v1 revision.

seq.description: The record's position in the stream, from 0.

requestID.description: The request's ID: the caller's --client-request-id when given, else one the CLI generated. Letters, digits and . _ : - only, starting with a letter or digit.

generationID.description: The take the record concerns, when it concerns one.

data.description: Type-specific facts; never text, transcripts, PCM or private paths. 64-bit values such as seeds are decimal strings.

oneOf.description: The final record: data is the command's envelope.

envelope.description: What every vocello command prints in --output-format json, and the data of the final result record in ndjson. A success has an object result and a null error; a failure has an error and, for a stopped batch, the partial result (every planned row).

schemaVersion.description: The envelope's schema version: 1 for every v1 revision.

command.description: The dotted canonical command path (generate, voices.list, models.install); empty when the invocation failed before any command resolved.

requestID.description: The request's ID: the caller's --client-request-id when given, else one the CLI generated. Letters, digits and . _ : - only, starting with a letter or digit.

result.description: The command's result object; null on a failure without a partial result.

error.description: Null on success, the error object on failure.

warnings.description: Conditions that did not stop the command, in the order they arose.

oneOf.description: Success: an object result and no error.
Failure: an error, and a result only when the command reports a partial outcome.

error.description: Why a command failed. code is the stable identifier; category and exitCode classify it as error-codes.json and exit-codes.json do; retryable is true exactly for the transient category.

code.description: The stable error code (error-codes.json). A consumer meeting a code it does not know falls back on category and exitCode.

category.description: The exit class of the code (exit-codes.json).

exitCode.description: The process exit status the CLI ends with; 143 replaces 130 for SIGTERM.

message.description: A human-readable English sentence; never parsed, and never text, transcripts or private paths.

retryable.description: True exactly when category is transient: the same request may succeed later.

retryAfterMs.description: A suggested wait before retrying, or null; set only when retryable.

hint.description: What the caller can do next, or null.

detail.description: Code-specific structured facts, or null; cancelled carries signal (SIGINT or SIGTERM).

meta.description: Facts about the run that produced the envelope.

vocelloVersion.description: The CLI's marketing version (CFBundleShortVersionString), or unknown.

contractRevision.description: The v1 contract revision the CLI implements (baseline.json).

durationMs.description: Wall-clock milliseconds from the command's start to the envelope.

replayed.description: True when the envelope is a stored result replayed for a repeated --client-request-id.

warning.description: A condition that did not stop the command.
